items.title: File Widerspruch against the Bescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter is dated Friday 2026-11-20; assuming it was posted the same day. Per the letter's own delivery rule ("ist er am vierten Tag nach dem Absenden bekannt gegeben") the Bescheid counts as bekannt gegeben on 2026-11-20 + 4 days = 2026-11-24 (Tuesday); this fictional delivery day is not shifted for weekends/holidays. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist then runs under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of bekanntgabe (24.11.) is not counted, so the period starts 2026-11-25 and ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of bekanntgabe, i.e. 2026-12-24 (Thursday). 24 December is not a statutory public holiday in NRW (Heiligabend is not a legal Feiertag), so no further shift under § 193 BGB applies. Final deadline: 2026-12-24.

warnings: The letter states the postal delivery fiction as the "vierten Tag nach dem Absenden" (fourth day after posting); the standard rule under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X is normally the third day after posting, so this deviation should be double-checked against the actual Bescheid wording, as it affects the start and end of the one-month Widerspruchsfrist.

The exact date on which the letter was actually posted (as opposed to its printed document date, 2026-11-20) is not stated, so the bekanntgabe date and therefore the deadline were computed assuming posting on the document date.
